Reference / http/retry

http/retry#

Sending a request once more when a reused connection closed before it answered.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let client = Retrying(HttpClient());

Description#

Sending a request once more when a reused connection closed before it answered.

Only HttpStaleConnection is retried, only once, and only for idempotent methods with replayable bodies. Every other failure goes to the caller.

Public API#

object Retrying#

object Retrying does Exchanging

Optional one-shot retry. Only the client transport can establish the stale before-response condition; ordinary errors and response failures propagate.

Retrying.Retrying#

Retrying(origin is Exchanging)

Sends through origin.

Retrying.response#

async response(request is Request) is ClientResponse

The response; one more attempt after HttpStaleConnection when that is safe.

One attempt.
